description: Use when someone asks about variances, conditional uses, rezonings or zoning appeals near an address: what a neighbor asked the city for, or whether a hearing is coming up. Covers Boston, Washington DC, San Francisco and Seattle. Give a city and street address, or a latitude and longitude. Each case has the city's own status words, our plain status label (Filed, In review, Hearing scheduled, Approved, Approved with conditions, Denied, Withdrawn or Other), the hearing date when the city publishes one, and a link to the city's case record. We never infer an outcome the city's record doesn't state. Owner and applicant names are left out.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '78 Pearl St'.

city.description: boston, washington-dc, san-francisco or seattle. Needed with address.

lat.description: Latitude, used instead of city and address.

lon.description: Longitude, used instead of city and address.

since.description: Earliest filing, hearing or decision date, YYYY-MM-DD, or 6m, 1y, 2y. Default 1y.

name: zoning_requests_near
title: Zoning requests near an address or a point
